content:
version: 1
# Every configured namespace has an independently sourced authority snapshot.
# Unknown or not-yet-snapshotted identifiers fail; there are no ignored prefixes.
namespaces:
  GO:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/ontology.json
    policy: canonical
  CHEBI:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/ontology.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  NCBITaxon:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/ontology.json
    policy: canonical
  RHEA:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/ontology.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  RHEA-COMP:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical
  metanetx.chemical:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical
  KEGG:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical
  EC:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  MIBiG:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  NCBIProtein:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  PathBank:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  MetaCyc:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  Reactome:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  SGD:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  UniProtKB:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  WikiPathways:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
  gomodel:
    snapshot: data/identifier_authorities/sources.json
    policy: canonical_or_synonym
contextual_labels:
  - namespace: CHEBI
    sections: [participants]
    record_prefixes: [MetaCyc]
    reason: Curated pathway steps preserve biochemical display names and formulas from reaction descriptions; the ChEBI identifier fixes the exact charge and stereochemical form.
  - namespace: CHEBI
    sections: [participants]
    record_prefixes: [WikiPathways]
    reason: GPML diagram labels preserve source display text after chemical cross-reference mapping.
  - namespace: CHEBI
    sections: [participants]
    record_prefixes: [Reactome, PathBank]
    reason: BioPAX display names preserve biochemical shorthand while ChEBI IDs specify the grounded chemical form.
  - namespace: EC
    sections: [participants]
    record_prefixes: [MetaCyc]
    reason: Pathway enzyme-step descriptions preserve activity and gene-context names rather than assert the current IUBMB recommended enzyme name.
  - namespace: RHEA
    sections: [reactions]
    record_prefixes: [MetaCyc, PathBank]
    reason: Curated pathway step labels describe enzyme function; the Rhea authority labels reaction equations.
  - namespace: SGD
    sections: [participants]
    record_prefixes: [gomodel, WikiPathways]
    reason: Source diagrams preserve gene symbols and organism or activity qualifiers such as Scer.
  - namespace: UniProtKB
    sections: [participants]
    record_prefixes: [MetaCyc, Reactome, WikiPathways, PathBank]
    reason: Pathway diagrams use gene symbols or enzyme-step names rather than the recommended protein name.
  - namespace: gomodel
    sections: [record, participants, reactions]
    record_prefixes: [gomodel]
    reason: GO-CAM records use curated pathway titles, native molecular instance descriptions, and activity descriptions; display cleanup removes import annotations and diagram markup without changing native graph IDs. Untyped native instances retain identity without asserting an external chemical identity.
  - namespace: WikiPathways
    sections: [participants, reactions]
    record_prefixes: [WikiPathways]
    reason: GPML interactions and diagram entities have native GraphIds; pathway records preserve their source-context descriptions without claiming an unresolved external chemical identity or canonical reaction name.
  - namespace: PathBank
    sections: [participants, reactions]
    record_prefixes: [PathBank]
    reason: Native BioPAX graph objects are scoped by their independently asserted SMPDB pathway accession; curated descriptions preserve chemical, complex or reaction context without making an external identity or canonical-name claim. The pathway title itself remains canonical.
  - namespace: PathBank
    sections: [participants]
    record_prefixes: [MetaCyc]
    reason: A MetaCyc pathway may cite an independently verified PathBank physical participant whose native identity preserves an assembly or molecular state. Its label describes that source object; biological membership and role require separate edge evidence. This rule preserves identifier existence and does not cover pathway titles or reaction labels.
  - namespace: MIBiG
    sections: [record]
    record_prefixes: [MIBiG]
    reason: A pathway record describes the biosynthetic gene cluster rather than asserting a product name as the canonical cluster title.
  - namespace: MetaCyc
    sections: [record, reactions]
    record_prefixes: [MetaCyc]
    reason: Curated titles and enzyme-step descriptions preserve the record's scoped presentation; the independently accessible native release verifies frame identity, not current preferred pathway naming.
  - namespace: Reactome
    sections: [record, reactions]
    record_prefixes: [Reactome]
    reason: Curated pathway and reaction titles add organism or enzyme context to native BioPAX display names.
